pricing.billingNote: Free collector-hosted web streaming and MP3 downloads.
pricing.freeTierNote: Full access to ~92,000 MP3 files across 2,100+ series.

provenance.primaryMasterSource: Aggregated collector hard drives including US, UK, Australian, and South African OTR transfers
provenance.airdateMethodology: Collector filename dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`); mixes researched logs with unverified trader estimates
provenance.castAttributionMethod: Series-level description only; no structured episode-level cast or character roles

specNotes.sha256_dedup: No cryptographic stream deduplication; duplicate and mislabeled trader episodes appear across series.
specNotes.vtt_subtitles: Zero .vtt caption tracks across 127,000+ MP3 files.
specNotes.schema_jsonld: Zero Schema.org JSON-LD markup or canonical recording UUIDs.

primary_source_verification.summary: Relies on collector MP3 filename dates without primary newspaper radio log citations.
primary_source_verification.evidenceQuote: "Dates are populated from collector file-naming conventions without primary source verification badges."

cast_credit_accuracy.summary: Series header blurbs mention main stars, but individual episode rows lack cast or character credits.
cast_credit_accuracy.evidenceQuote: "Episode rows display only date, episode number, title, duration, and MP3 play/download controls."

vtt_transcripts.summary: Zero WebVTT transcripts or searchable spoken dialogue.

master_provenance.summary: Wide variance in audio quality: some rare 128k collector rips sit beside muffled 24–32 kbps multi-gen cassette transfers.
master_provenance.evidenceQuote: "Aggregates disparate collector sets without transfer lineage or bitrate floor enforcement."

serial_continuity.summary: Strong coverage of long-running Australian/UK/US multi-part serials (e.g., *Speed Gibson*, *Tarzan*, *2000 Plus*) in sequential order.
serial_continuity.evidenceQuote: "Preserves sequential episode numbering across multi-hundred-episode Commonwealth and US serials."

open_api_export.summary: Direct single-file MP3 download links, but no public JSON API, no RSS feeds, and AJAX-paginated DOM tables.
open_api_export.evidenceQuote: "Uses client-side paginated HTML views without a documented REST API or podcast RSS feeds."

ad_free_playback.summary: Free, ad-free playback and direct MP3 downloads.
ad_free_playback.evidenceQuote: "Free streaming and downloading with no subscription paywall or mid-roll ads."

dedup_integrity.summary: Organized into one page per series, but retains unverified 'aka' duplicate episodes within uncertified series.
dedup_integrity.evidenceQuote: "Single series page structure reduces container sprawl, though internal duplicate encodes persist."

gotchas.title: Zero Episode Synopses or Cast Credits on 90%+ of Catalog
gotchas.detail: Most episodes show only a bare title and date string, making it impossible to verify actors, characters, or plot details without listening.

gotchas.title: No Transcripts, RSS Feeds, or Programmatic API
gotchas.detail: Cannot subscribe to series in a podcast player or query metadata via JSON.
